module_summary: Synchronous valid/ready FIFO: flat register array indexed by head/tail pointers with an occupancy counter producing full/empty, plus synchronous flush.

anchors.name: bank
anchors.why: DEPTH x WIDTH flattened entry array written at tail, read at head.

anchors.name: tl
anchors.why: Write pointer selecting slot for in_data; increments on push, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: hd
anchors.why: Read pointer selecting out_data slot; increments on pop, cleared by flush.

anchors.name: lvl
anchors.why: Occupancy count; drives full/empty flags and count output.

anchors.name: in_valid
anchors.why: Push request; with not-full enables write.

anchors.name: in_ready
anchors.why: Asserted while FIFO is not full.

anchors.name: in_data
anchors.why: Write payload stored into bank at tail.

anchors.name: out_valid
anchors.why: Asserted while FIFO is not empty.

anchors.name: out_ready
anchors.why: Consumer ready; with non-empty pops the head entry.

anchors.name: out_data
anchors.why: Read payload: bank entry at head pointer.

anchors.name: flush_i
anchors.why: Flush request clearing head, tail and occupancy count.

anchors.name: ins
anchors.why: Push enable: writes bank, advances tail, increments level.

anchors.name: rem
anchors.why: Pop enable: advances head and decrements level.

groups.name: fifo_storage
groups.description: Flattened register array holding DEPTH entries.

groups.name: pointer_control
groups.description: Head/tail pointers, occupancy counter, full/empty flags and flush.

groups.name: write_port
groups.description: Valid/ready push interface gated by not-full.

groups.name: read_port
groups.description: Valid/ready pop interface gated by not-empty.
